fontsize.description: Font size in points or 'WxH' format (e.g., '16', '8x16'). Must match the selected font.

codepage.description: Character encoding used on the console (e.g., 'UTF-8', 'ISO-8859-1', 'CP850')

variant.description: Keyboard layout variant (e.g., 'dvorak', 'colemak', 'intl'). Leave empty for default variant.

compose_key.description: Key to use as Compose (e.g., 'RightAlt', 'CapsLock'). Leave empty to disable.

termtype.description: Terminal type string (TERM) reported to applications (e.g., 'linux', 'xterm', 'vt220').

warn_about_missing_keymap.description: Set to 'true' to enable warnings for missing keymap files, or 'false' to silence them.

fontpaths.description: Colon-separated list of additional font directories (e.g., '/usr/share/fonts/:/usr/local/share/fonts/').

unicode_fallback.description: Set to 'true' to enable Unicode fallback rendering for missing glyphs, or 'false' to disable.

inactive_minutes.description: Number of minutes of inactivity before the screen blanks (0 = never blank).

splash.description: Set to 'true' to enable the boot splash logo, or 'false' to disable it.

hwcursor.description: Set to 'true' to enable the hardware cursor, or 'false' to use software cursor.
